broken.label: {entry}
broken.next: fix that record (in the spec PR, or in the repo that holds {entry})

departure-inside.label: {entry}
departure-inside.next: change plan.md (the next round writes tasks.md again from it); draft a superseding record into the spec PR (planner ADR-0009 d3); or resume with adr_ruling naming {entry}, {record}, {path} and your reason

departure-outside.label: {entry}
departure-outside.next: change plan.md (the next round writes tasks.md again from it); change record {record} in the repo that holds {entry}; or resume with adr_ruling naming {entry}, {record}, {path} and your reason

empty.label: codeworks.toml
empty.what: No ADR folder is listed in [shared] adr_folders

git.label: git
git.next: run from a git checkout of the repo, then resume

github.label: GitHub
github.next: resume to run the check again

guard-asked.label: adr-asked.json
guard-asked.next: resume to run the check again

guard-paths.label: {file}
guard-paths.next: resume to run the check again

guard-rulings.label: adr-rulings.json
guard-rulings.next: remove the entry; only a resume with adr_ruling adds one
guard-rulings.what: entry {folder} {record} {path} was not written by the check

rounds.label: adr-check
rounds.next: discard the run's changes to {spec}, then start again: {again}
rounds.what: the check ran 100 rounds in one run

ruling-refused.label: adr_ruling
ruling-refused.next: resume with a corrected adr_ruling, or without one

settings.label: codeworks.toml
settings.next: fix codeworks.toml at HEAD, then resume

step-unfinished.label: adr-check
step-unfinished.next: fix what the step's error names, then resume
step-unfinished.what: step {steps} did not finish this round (no done record)

stop-unread.label: adr-stop.json
stop-unread.next: resume to run the check again

sub-issues-extra.label: #{issue}
sub-issues-extra.next: remove them from #{issue}'s sub-issues, or add their stories to spec.md, then resume

sub-issues-foreign.label: #{issue}
sub-issues-foreign.next: remove it from #{issue}'s sub-issues, then resume

sub-issues-misplaced.label: #{issue}
sub-issues-misplaced.next: order #{issue}'s sub-issues so sub-issue {position} is US{position}'s issue, then resume
sub-issues-misplaced.what: sub-issue {position} is #{sub}, but tasks.md labels US{position} with {label}

tasks-empty.label: tasks.md
tasks-empty.next: delete tasks.md, then resume: the next round writes it again from the plan
tasks-empty.what: no task line names a path

tasks-refused.label: {where}
tasks-refused.next: delete tasks.md, then resume: the next round writes it again from the plan; if the line comes back, change spec.md or plan.md first

tasks-unfinished.label: tasks.md
tasks-unfinished.next: resume to run the check again
tasks-unfinished.what: the tasks command did not answer (its exit code is not 0)

touches-missing.label: touches.json
touches-missing.next: resume to run the check again

touches-refused.label: touches.json
touches-refused.next: resume to run the check again

touches-stale.label: touches.json
touches-stale.next: resume to run the check again
touches-stale.what: plan.md or spec.md changed after this round listed the plan's paths

verdict-mismatch.label: {entry}
verdict-mismatch.next: resume to run the check again

verdict-unread.label: adr-verdict.json
verdict-unread.next: resume to run the check again
